title: Apple announces a "Welcome home" event on October 13 at 9am ET in NYC, where it is expected to unveil a "HomePad", a new Apple TV, LG home accessories, and more (Ryan Christoffel/9to5Mac)
summary: Ryan Christoffel / 9to5Mac: Apple announces a “Welcome home” event on October 13 at 9am ET in NYC, where it is expected to unveil a “HomePad”, a new Apple TV, LG home accessories, and more — Today Apple announced a special event happening next Tuesday, October 13 with the tagline 'Welcome home.
contentText:
Ryan Christoffel / 9to5Mac :

Apple announces a “Welcome home” event on October 13 at 9am ET in NYC, where it is expected to unveil a “HomePad”, a new Apple TV, LG home accessories, and more   —  Today Apple announced a special event happening next Tuesday, October 13 with the tagline 'Welcome home.
